title: A merge trial files no flaky item for the item's own new test
description: Run the real loop cycle against a real temporary Postgres control plane and a scratch bare Git remote: a candidate adding its own test that fails once and passes its rerun merges, and master status lists no 'Flaky check on main' item, since main lacks that test.

steps.name: Merge a candidate whose own new test fails once through the real loop and read master status
